title: Bravyi-Kitaev [[15, 1, 3]] 15-to-1 Magic State Distillation Factory Savings of Adaptive R_Z Peeling
claims: Under concatenated Bravyi-Kitaev [[15, 1, 3]] 15-to-1 distillation (p_out = 35 p_in^3 / ((1-p_in)^{15} + 35 p_in^3)), reducing fine non-Clifford rotations by (m - 1)x via adaptive R_Z peeling saves > (m - 1)x in raw magic states at matched distillation depth L.

Across the L=1 -> L=2 distillation level threshold (e.g. m=32, p_raw=1e-3, eps=1e-4), adaptive peeling requires L=1 while QFT_{2^m}^dagger requires L=2, achieving a >451x reduction in total raw magic states.
favorable_controls: Threshold step-down m=32 (451.16x raw T-state reduction)
